description: Models with a retirement date on or before `before` (YYYY-MM-DD), soonest first, optionally for one lab: status, API id, date and precision, replacement, source. Tentative (not-before) dates are left out unless include_tentative is true.

lab.description: lab name or key, e.g. OpenAI, mistral-ai

name: list_retirements

announcedAt.description: date the lab announced the deprecation

apiId.description: the lab's model id from its own page

checkedAt.description: when the tracker last read the lab's pages for this row

datePrecision.description: as in list_deadlines: exact: the stated day; earliest: the earliest possible day as the lab states it; not_before: not before this day, no retirement date is set and the model is not deprecated

replacement.description: the replacement's tracker row when the lab names exactly one tracked model

replacementStated.description: replacement(s) as the lab names them

retirementDatePrecision.description: exact: the stated day; earliest: the earliest possible day as the lab states it; tentative: deprecated name of not_before (read datePrecision)

sources.description: per value {url, asOf}: the lab's page and the date it was last read

title: List retirements
